description:
Offline chess against Maia-3 with local Stockfish analysis

Mobile Maia is a free, open-source Android chess app for playing against Maia-3, a human-like model from the University of Toronto Computational Social Science Lab, and analysing games alongside Stockfish.

Everything runs on your device: no account, subscription, ads, or Internet connection is needed. The Maia-3 79M model, Stockfish 19 Light, opening database, saved games, and analysis are available offline.

Play:

  • Choose White, Black, or a random side and a Play Maia rating from 600 to 2600
  • Use unlimited play, clock presets, or custom minutes and increment
  • Adjust human-like move timing, Temperature, and Top-P
  • Use single or multiple premoves, with an optional 100 ms penalty
  • Take back moves, offer endgame draws, play rematches, and restore unfinished games
  • Enable optional move sounds and haptic feedback
  • Find recent games by player side, Maia rating, result, and date

Explore and learn:

  • Compare move probabilities from two Maia ratings alongside two Stockfish suggestions
  • See agreement between the engines with arrows on the board
  • Run Fast, Balanced, or Thorough full-game analysis; Fast is the default for new or reset settings
  • Review accuracy, the evaluation graph, and Brilliant, Good, Interesting, Dubious, Mistake, and Blunder annotations
  • Import FEN or PGN, edit positions, and build persistent nested variations
  • Continue from an analysed position with a choice of side, playing strength, and clock for that game, without changing Home preferences
  • Look up offline opening names and ECO codes
  • Save and share PGN with variations, annotations, and historical clocks

Experimental Chessnut support includes board LEDs, sounds, battery status, reconnect recovery, and the option to finish a board game on the phone. Board play supports unlimited games from the standard starting position; USB and Analysis Board input are not supported.

The bundled offline model makes the universal APK approximately 435 MiB. Mobile Maia is an independent community project under AGPL-3.0-only and is not an official Maia Chess, Lichess, Stockfish, or Chessnut application.
